llm.summary: This is an educational insurance Q&A skill with no code execution, credentials, persistence, or hidden data access; its main risk is overly broad or China-specific guidance being applied in the wrong context.

dimensions.detail: The skill is static Markdown guidance and does not request local file access, network access, credentials, account actions, or mutation authority.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Only artifact/SKILL.md is present; no install scripts, executable files, dependency installation, remote fetch, or tool registration behavior was found.

dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes generic Chinese phrases such as "怎么选", "哪个好", and "是什么意思", and the content is China-focused, so invocation and jurisdiction should be scoped carefully.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, memory writes, background worker, scheduled task, privilege escalation, or tool hijacking behavior appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact is coherent with its stated purpose: insurance terminology, product comparison frameworks, coverage analysis, FAQ guidance, and educational decision support.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should treat this as general insurance education, not professional advice or a product recommendation. It is best used for China insurance questions; for other jurisdictions or current regulatory details, users should confirm the applicable location and check official or professional sources.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger phrases are a real quality/scoping issue, but the artifact only provides insurance education and does not gain sensitive authority or access; this does not justify Review by itself.
[SQP-3] expected: China-specific insurance context is disclosed in the description and content. Users outside that context should confirm jurisdiction, but the locale focus is purpose-aligned rather than hidden.
